minutes.headline: Select Board deferred many special town meeting recommendations; Il Forno hearing continued to Nov 1 for floor plans.
minutes.summary: The board ratified a Council on Aging van driver, recessed the Il Forno alteration hearing for floor plans, and went through the special town meeting warrant article by article, approving some, disapproving others and deferring several pending final numbers. The APDC chair said his bylaw article was not ready. A draft environmental policy was introduced and the donation bin problem discussed before an executive session on collective bargaining.

what_happened.line: The Select Board went through the special town meeting warrant article by article, recommending approval of some, disapproval of others, and deferring several.
The board deferred Article 1, the budget adjustment, until the final new growth number is known.
A recommendation of disapproval on Article 12, the Ritter windows, failed on a tie, and the board then moved to defer it to town meeting.
The board recommended disapproval of moving town meeting to April, 4-0, and of the capital line item veto article, 3-1.
The Il Forno hearing on adding a permanent structure was continued to November 1, with the applicant to submit floor plans.

why_it_matters: Several warrant articles reach special town meeting without a Select Board recommendation, so residents voting there will have less guidance on spending items.
The Article 1 budget adjustment and the Article 4 funding both depend on a new growth figure not yet certified, and that figure sets how much money is available without new taxes.
The firefighter on-call time buyback was deferred partly because its cost to the retirement system is unknown, so its effect on the town budget, mostly taxes, is not yet stated.
watch_next: The Il Forno alteration-of-premises hearing resumes November 1 at 7:15 pm, when floor plans are due.
The new growth certification, which the board said it is waiting on before recommending Articles 1 and 4.
